# ArbitraryWavefunctionConfigurability

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The capability to set wavefunction profiles to arbitrary target shapes by tuning imaginary gauge fields, independent of lattice geometry. Offers a reconfigurable basis for implementing complex computational tasks, such as pattern recognition or reservoir dynamics, directly in the optical domain.
